en: --- MG ν Gundam HWS “Ver.Ka” completed. ---
Over-the-counter sales An expansion set that can be jointed with the MS main body (sold separately) to reproduce the HWS equipped type!
*This product does not include the MS body.
Jointed with the in-store product "MG νGundam Ver.Ka" (sold separately), parts that can reproduce the νGundam HWS equipped type are set and commercialized as an HWS expansion set.
● Includes a set of heavy armor & weapons that reproduces the HWS equipment type!
● Reproduced with molding colors that conform to the MS body sold in stores!
●Enjoy νGundam HWS in “MG Ver.Ka” with newly designed markings included as water transfer decals!
Also includes markings for the MS itself to help improve the finish.
[Set contents]
Chest armor unit / Front armor unit / Leg armor and thruster unit / Shoulder missile launcher /
Hyper Mega Seal / Hyper Mega Rifle / “Ver.Ka” water transfer decal
This product is expanded to "MG 1/100 νGundam Ver.Ka" (sold separately) which is currently being released at stores nationwide.
A set of 'heavy armor and weapon' to reproduce the 'HWS (Heavy Weapon System) equipped type'.
*The MS body is not included with this product.
* To reproduce the published photo, this product and "MG 1/100 νGundam Ver.Ka" (sold separately) are required.
Also, "MG 1/100 νGundam Ver.Ka" (sold separately) is available for sale at Premium Bandai.
None.
* Hyper Mega Rifle has a beam rifle built into it.
The built-in beam rifle uses the one that comes with the main product.
*Hyper Mega Seal is designed to be jointed with regular Seal.
For normal Seal, use the one that comes with the main product.
* The additional armor is heavy, so please refer to the poses in the photo and display it in a stable location.
1/100 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Main product material: PS
・No adhesive is used for assembly
《MG 1/100 νGundam Ver.Ka is not included in this product》
*The finished product in the photo is a prototype that is still under development. Also a painted item. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
(remarks)
・This product cannot be purchased at stores that carry plastic models.
・This product may be sold at events sponsored by our company or other projects, or overseas.
・ There is a limited number of this product available for sale at 'Premium Bandai'. Please note that the item may be out of stock.
・Due to production availability, we are limiting the quantity of this product that can be purchased per person.
